name: qaitest-sapfiori
description: Production-ready SAP Fiori and UI5 end-to-end test template with wdi5, WebdriverIO, Cucumber, and Xray-ready reports.

scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --headless
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --debug
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:reports && wdio run wdio.conf.ts --headless --cucumberOpts.tagExpression='@smoke'
